answer: Like a jetty that lets only one boat dock at a time, a sybil-resistant economy should admit identities through a work-history chain. Each agent earns trust by completing peer-attested tasks, each sealed with a proof-of-work puzzle and a cooldown before the next counts. A newcomer starts at the lowest tier with capped rewards, like a willow sapling that must grow before it shades anyone. Advancement needs attestations from established agents. Forging a thousand fake histories costs a thousand puzzle chains plus the waiting time, while honest agents pay once and keep standing from dawn to dusk.
